name: training-creator
description: Design practical, audience-aware IT training programs using the Skills4-IT training methodology, including needs analysis, learning objectives, course flow, assessments, instructor briefs and delivery-readiness checks.

interface.shortDescription: Design practical IT training from need to delivery
interface.longDescription: Skills4-IT workflows for training-needs analysis, audience differentiation, measurable learning objectives, practical course design, assessments, instructor briefing, delivery readiness and adaptation.
defaultPrompt: Design a one-day technical training for this audience.
Analyze this client training request before building the course.
Create measurable learning objectives for this training.
Prepare the instructor brief for this client training.
Review whether this training is ready to deliver.
Adapt this training for a less technical audience.
